experiment: camera-combo eval: does more camera input improve robot manipulation
task: Place the yellow screwdriver in the bowl.
disabled_cameras_cutoff_method: No cameras were labelled DISABLED in camera_combo 1 (all three cameras: logitech, realsense, and wrist were ENABLED and active).
camera_evidence_at_end: All three cameras confirm success: Logitech top-down view (end_logitech.jpg) shows the yellow screwdriver lying completely inside the grey bowl with the gripper retracted to the bottom of the frame; RealSense side view (end_realsense.jpg) shows the table surface to the right of the bowl is now empty (the screwdriver is inside the bowl); Wrist camera view (end_wrist.jpg) shows the yellow screwdriver resting inside the grey bowl between the open retracted gripper jaws.
problems_encountered: No hardware faults or crashes occurred. On step 11, lowering shoulder_lift to 1450 with elbow_flex at 1750 lightly touched the table behind the screwdriver handle (stopping shoulder_lift at 1516); increasing elbow_flex to 1922 and adjusting wrist_flex to 1883 positioned the jaws directly around the screwdriver handle for a clean grasp and placement into the bowl.
